title: Wonderful beach and boat tour!
text: Our guide and drivers were excellent. Ours was a large family group and everyone enjoyed the sightseeing, boat ride and quiet extra time on the beaches ( yes two different beaches!) the boat was a thrill! Our guide Vincent was very helpful and accommodating. Highly recommended to him and this tour!
author: michaelsU872KY

title: Noelia was a fabulous guide
text: Noelia was an excellent guide. We opted to spend more time at the different beaches and swimming. It was a perfect family day instead of so much time in tours that kids don’t enjoy. We had lunch a great spot, enjoyed a cappuccino in a cute town and the kids just loved swimming in the gulf of roses
author: Navigate20325144358

title: A Memorable Costa Brava Experience
text: The day tour to Costa Brava from Barcelona with Vincent and Joaquin was an absolute delight. They took great care throughout the trip, making sure everyone felt comfortable and engaged. Vincent’s explanations were clear, informative, and full of interesting details that brought the region’s history and beauty to life. The journey was well-paced, and their friendly approach made the entire experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this tour with Vincent and Joaquin for anyone visiting Barcelona!
author: Departure48061229674

title: Unforgettable Day in Costa Brava with Vincent & Joaquín
text: My daughter and I just returned from an incredible day tour in Costa Brava with Vincent and Joaquín. From start to finish, it was such a memorable experience! Vincent was warm, engaging, and shared so much interesting knowledge along the way. We visited three breathtaking spots, enjoyed a wonderful boat ride to Tossa de Mar, and ended the day climbing up the castle with the most spectacular views. It was truly the highlight of our trip to Spain. Thank you, Vincent and Joaquín, for an unforgettable day! 🙏
author: Tali H

title: Costa Brava tour
text: Our guide Vincent and our driver Joaquin were simply amazing! They made us feel so welcome, helped us with absolutely everything, showed us around with such care, and shared so many interesting stories and facts. Thanks to them, we discovered so much more than we ever expected. We’ll always remember this experience with a smile! Thank you!!!
author: Chris B

title: Delightful Excursion
text: This was a wonderful day trip for our family of four (two adults, two teens). Gaspar was an excellent guide - one of the best we've ever during our travels. He communicated with us before the excursion to confirm timing, was very knowledgeable, friendly, and flexible, and tracked the weather during our trip to ensure that we could shift activities around as needed. We thought this was the perfect way to get out of Barcelona for a day and explore. Also, the archaeological museum at the ruins, while small, is very impressive.
author: melissamS3467HT

title: Costa Brava
